name: Provenance
summary: Ensemble AI-content detector (GPT-2 perplexity, conformally calibrated classifier, C2PA, watermarking) with per-sentence attribution and an Attack Lab that stress-tests every detector.
highlights: Attack Lab with T5 paraphrase attacks

name: Il Colosseo
summary: Three Gemini agents (two debaters and a judge) argue over three rounds, grounded in live web research and streamed over FastAPI + SSE, with debates in 10 Indian languages.

name: DawaiSathi
summary: Consumer pharma MVP (10+ users): snap a strip or type a medicine name to get plain-language usage, side effects and warnings in 11 Indian languages via Gemini.

name: Temporal Belief Dynamics in BERT
summary: Mapped how BERT's internal "beliefs" evolve across 10 fine-tuning epochs with graph-theoretic networks and 2D embeddings. Published at ICCIS 2025 (Springer LNCS).
highlights: Accepted at ICCIS 2025, BITS Pilani Goa (Springer LNCS)
